title: You need an Engineering degree to put or get the handle on.
text: You need an Engineering degree to put or get the handle on.. This is the most ridiculous thing I've ever seen. I absolutely cannot get the handles on these jars. My BIGGEST concern is why weren't they on the jars when they are shipped, it wouldn't have added anything to the packing or weight or anything? I cannot get the handles to meet to be able to get them around the bottom lip of the jar. It just shouldn't be this hard for God's sake. For what I paid for these jars, those handles should have been put on the jar at the factory. I WILL NEVER BUY ANY OF THESE AGAIN. After unpacking both of the jars I noticed one of them has a dented lid and the other lid just kept turning and turning. These also do NOT have any seal inside the lid so nothing will stay fresh, so if that's what you're looking at these for, look again, these have no seal whatsoever in the lid. Bad purchase for me. Sending them back.
